channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Era of terrorism in region over once and for all: Erdoğan
item.description: The operation conducted by the Syrian army against the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF), which resulted in the latter’s withdrawal from the critical sites, has ended the era of terrorism in the region, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan has said, calling on all the actors to exert efforts for stability and peace in the region.

item.title: Türkiye's conservation labs revive thousands of ancient artifacts
item.description: Ministry of Culture and Tourism is conducting extensive conservation and restoration work in its specialized regional laboratories, where experts meticulously preserve and restore historical artifacts — including those repatriated from abroad, damaged by time or recently discovered — to safeguard Türkiye's rich cultural heritage for future generations.

item.title: Home sales rise 14 percent in 2025 to some 1.7 million units
item.description: Türkiye’s housing market recorded its highest sales on record in 2025, with nationwide transactions rising 14.3 percent compared to the previous year to reach 1.69 million units, data from the Turkish Statistical Institute (TÜİK) showed on Jan. 20.

item.title: Massive drug bust nets hundreds of suspects across Türkiye
item.description: Turkish security forces have carried out what Interior Minister Ali Yerlikaya described as the “most comprehensive narcotics operation,” detaining more than 600 suspects in an operation centered in the western province of İzmir.

item.title: Turkish navy launches three-month NATO mission
item.description: Türkiye’s leading warship task force embarked on Jan. 20 on an 87-day mission to participate in a NATO exercise spanning four seas.

item.title: Turkish top diplomat meets US envoy over Syria developments
item.description: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan met with United States Ambassador to Türkiye and special envoy to Syria Tom Barrack on Jan. 20 to discuss the recent developments in Syria that resulted in an agreement between Damascus and the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF).

item.title: EU vows 'unflinching' response to Trump's Greenland gambit
item.description: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen vowed on Tuesday an "unflinching" response to Donald Trump's threats over Greenland, as the U.S. president said he was ready to hold a meeting in Davos about the Arctic island.

item.title: Türkiye condemns YPG-linked attack on flag at Syria border as provocation
item.description: A terrorist YPG-linked attack on the Turkish flag along the Turkish-Syrian border is an “open provocation targeting the nation’s peace,” said Türkiye's communications chief on Tuesday.

item.title: Trump confirms Putin invited to join 'Board of Peace'
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump confirmed on Monday that his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin was invited to join the "Board of Peace."

item.title: US envoy urges YPG to integrate into Syrian state
item.description: The United States’ ambassador to Ankara and special envoy for Syria, Tom Barrack, called on the PKK-linked YPG to integrate into Syria’s new central government, saying Washington no longer views the group as its primary partner.
